title: BDO: what return on common equity supports a premium to book?
scope: Retrospective model-consistency example using FY2025 figures published in 2026, not a contemporaneous trade or current target.

assumptions.roe_basis: Illustrative sustainable beginning-book ROE, rounded below reported 14.4% return on average common equity; these denominators differ. Not a forecast inferred directly from the reported ratio.
assumptions.return_basis: Selected 12% equity hurdle; test 10%, 12%, 14%. Not a calibrated CAPM estimate.
assumptions.growth_basis: Selected 3% perpetual common-book growth; imposes retention=g/ROE and payout=1-g/ROE. Not a claim about declared dividends or distributable regulatory capital.

limitations: No independent forward earnings or capital forecast.
Book value may require credit, fair-value and other comprehensive income adjustments.
Sources flag historical per-share adjustments for the May 2025 property dividend.
Agreement across formulas uses identical assumptions and is not independent investment corroboration.

dividend_policy_check.scope: Annualized regular cash policy, not actual FY2025 cash received, total shareholder distributions, or a guaranteed future dividend. The 2026 declaration corroborates the quarterly amount; it is not information available at the 2025 year-end.

common_equity_reconciliation.scope: BDO Unibank Group, not standalone Parent Bank
common_equity_reconciliation.verification: Text extraction and rendered-page inspection. Reconciles reported common book equity, not economic fair-value adjustments.
